user.title: Connect Uber Eats
user.description:
Use a computer with Chrome, Edge, or Firefox. You do not need an active order.

1. Open [ubereats.com](https://www.ubereats.com/) in another tab and sign in to the account you want to connect.
2. Press **F12** to open **Developer Tools**. If it does not open, press **Ctrl+Shift+I** (Mac: **Command+Option+I**).
3. Select the **Network** tab. Leave Developer Tools open and **reload the Uber Eats page** to display its requests.
4. In the Network **Filter** box, type **getActiveOrdersV1**. If nothing appears, clear the filter, reload again, and try **getUserV1**.
5. **Right-click the matching request** in the list. Select **Copy → Copy as cURL**. If offered a choice, use **cURL (bash)**.
6. Return here and **paste the entire copied text** into **Uber Eats session** below. Check your time zone and select **Submit**.

Copy the request only; you do not need to run it in a terminal. It contains access to your account: paste it only here and do not share it.

import_legacy.title: Import existing Uber Eats account
import_legacy.description: Select an existing legacy account. Its cookies are validated before creating a new account. The old configuration entry is kept. Unloaded entities can retain their entity IDs when no conflicts exist. Loaded or conflicting entities keep their original registration.

error.invalid_cookie: The copied text does not contain the required Uber Eats session details. Copy the complete request using Copy → Copy as cURL (bash), then paste it again.
error.invalid_timezone: Select a valid IANA time zone.
error.invalid_auth: Uber Eats rejected this session. Sign in to ubereats.com again, reload the page with Network open, and copy a new request.
error.cannot_connect: Uber Eats is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

init.title: Courier privacy
init.description: Phone and photo attributes are off by default. Enabling them can store personal courier information in Home Assistant Recorder and backups. Turning them off does not erase existing history. Configure Recorder exclusions if needed.
